data.name: Dev
data.gender_notes: Dev is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root div, 'to shine' — deva, 'a god, a shining one'. Its root is Sanskrit div (दिव्). A common Sanskrit term for a deity. Dev is a Sanskrit name meaning “God; divine; shining one”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dev expresses “God; divine; shining one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root div, 'to shine' — deva, 'a god, a shining one'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dev total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

vedic_reference.note: Devas or gods in Hinduism, are the divine beings, who have control over various natural phenomena and elements. They are described as the 'shining ones' or 'luminous ones', and are believed to be the creators of the universe. They are often depicted as having various powers, such as the power to grant boons, protect, and bestow blessings.
